data.name: Aasman
data.gender_notes: Aasman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘as-sama’, meaning ‘the sky’ or ‘the heavens’. It is a name that evokes a sense of spiritual connection to the divine realm, reminding us of the vast expanse of Allah’s creation. The name Aasman carries the meaning “Sky, heaven” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aasman usually hope their child will grow to embody sky, heaven and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of our connection to the divine and the vastness of Allah’s creation.
data.etymology: Aasman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sky, heaven.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aasman total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: آسمان
in_arabic.long_meaning: آسمان هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'أَسْمَنَ' والذي يعني الرفع أو العلو. في اللغة العربية، يرمز هذا الاسم إلى السماء أو المكان العالي. وفي السياق الإسلامي، يمكن أن يُفسر على أنه اسم يعبر عن علو الله تعالى وسموه.

in_urdu.name: آسمان
in_urdu.meaning: آسمان تعالی کا نام ہے جو بلند و بالا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: آسمان ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'سماء' یا 'عالم بالا'. یہ نام اللہ تعالی کی عظمت و جلالت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اردو میں، یہ نام مذکر کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے اور اس کا تلفظ 'آسمان' ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: आसमान
in_hindi.meaning: आसमान परम उच्च और दिव्य नाम है
in_hindi.long_meaning: आसमान एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है 'स्वर्ग' या 'उच्च स्थान'। यह नाम ईश्वर की महानता और उच्चता को दर्शाता है। हिंदी में, यह नाम पुरुष के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है और इसका उच्चारण 'आसमान' होता है।

in_pashto.name: آسمـان
in_pashto.meaning: آسمـان د لوړوالي او برترۍ نوم دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: آسمـان د عربي نژاد نوم دی چې معنا يې 'سماء' يا 'لوړ ځای' دی. دا نوم د الله تعالی د عظمت او برترۍ څرګندونه کوي. په پښتو کې، دا نوم د مذکر په توګه کارول کیږي او تلفظ يې 'آسمـان' دی.

in_english.name: Aasman
in_english.long_meaning: Aasman is an Arabic-originated name meaning 'sky', 'heaven', or 'high place'. It symbolizes elevation, spirituality, and divine connection. In Islamic tradition, the name Aasman signifies Allah's sublimity and transcendence. The name has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting its universal appeal and deep-rooted etymology from the Arabic root 'asma', meaning 'to raise' or 'to elevate'.
